identity_semantics.rationale: The codec contract concerns value shape and version behavior, not object identity.

input_immutability.requirement: Encoding must not mutate the supplied order value.

idempotency.rationale: The codec is a pure value transformation with no command replay or persisted side effect.

compatibility.requirement: Version 1 decoding and default encoding remain unchanged; version 2 round-trips to the same normalized decoded shape.
